prompt:
Create an ORIGINAL pixel-art ICON CONCEPT REVIEW BOARD for Võ Lâm Hero Defense, Thiên Sơn WIND school. PHASE1 CONCEPT ONLY / PENDING APPROVAL. Not final production icons.
Input1 is the approved exact Thiên Sơn character/weapon design. Input2 is its approved curved dao atlas. Input3 establishes the exact ink-teal/ivory/jade icon family with thin jade rim and NO heavy outer frame. Do not alter approved character art.
Landscape 1536x1024 pale parchment same review-board family, with THREE LARGE isolated SQUARE ICONS side by side, about384px each, abundant margins. Labels OUTSIDE: exact Vietnamese name + ASCII ID + NORMAL ATTACK or INNATE PASSIVE as appropriate. No labels, numbers or hotkeys inside icon art. Draw only the three icon concepts, no character posing, VFX aura, animation frames or game screenshot. Lower notes may say 'Approved basic animation reused' under normals and 'Icon only / no persistent aura' under passive.
Shared icon rendering: deliberate crisp detailed wuxia pixel clusters, upper-left light, deep INK-TEAL background, restrained jade inner rim, 10% silhouette padding, ivory/silver main shapes with jade and tiny pale-blue accents. Match input3's crisp wind school style; distinct silhouettes at64/48/32px. Wind never ice; no snow, frost, shards, blue flames or lightning.
Three icon subjects LEFT TO RIGHT:
Thiên Sơn Phiến / thien_son_phien (normal): ONE clean ivory open folding combat FAN, dark jade ribs and edge, a SINGLE tiny near-edge wind accent. No flurry/triple arcs; fan silhouette dominates. Definition: Normal fan melee attack; reuse approved character animation.
Thiên Sơn Đao / thien_son_dao (normal): ONE simple curved SILVER Chinese DAO with jade handle and silver guard on a clear diagonal. No dash streaks or multi-cut flurry; blade silhouette dominates. Definition: Normal curved dao melee attack; reuse approved character animation.
Bắc Minh Thần Công / bac_minh_than_cong (passive): A centered JADE DISC/MEDALLION holding a hollow S-shaped WHITE WIND CURRENT and a small silver pinpoint. Balanced quiet internal-energy emblem; no Yin-Yang dots, snowflake, shield or active slash. Definition: Innate movement/attack-speed/crit growth; icon only. No persistent aura proposed.
The basic fan must look simpler and quieter than input3 Liên Hoa's rapid layered fan arcs. Basic dao must be a simple readable weapon with no speed lines. Passive is a quiet jade medallion with a hollow S air-current (not Yin Yang), no aura around character because there is NO character in this board. Keep icons square and separate for later concept extraction.
